summary: Retest of the 2 HIGH bugs from iteration_21, plus a multi-package regression. All done through the UI (admin test@preview.com) with DB checks. BUG 1 FIXED: created A×2 ($84) with the Nuevo form, then edited it in single mode to B×3. The edit total was 156.00. The list shows 'Categoría B - $156.00 • 3 paquetes' and invoice shipping_cost is 156. The courier widget is $135 (45×3). The Packages Report shows B / 3 paq / 1 client / $156 (KPIs 3 paq, $156). DB shipment.packages=None. BUG 2 FIXED: on Wed Oct 21 23:48 UTC the week Select defaulted to 'Jueves 15-Octubre - Miércoles 21-Octubre (0)'. That matches an option, and the DB has no shipments that week, so it is empty correctly. After the week changed at Thu 00:00 the default became 'Jueves 22-Octubre - Miércoles 28-Octubre' and new shipments showed on load and after reload. REGRESSION PASS: G×1 + B×2 create makes the form total $136.00 and the card 'G×1 · B×2 - $136.00 • 3 paquetes'. The edit dialog shows 2 package rows (1×$32=$32, 2×$52=$104) and a readOnly total 136.00. The helper text reads 'Suma de todos los paquetes según su categoría.' and the tracking button reads 'Agregar Tracking'. Changing B qty to 3 recalculates to 188.00. Save persists: card 'G×1 · B×3 - $188.00 • 4 paquetes', DB packages [G1/32, B3/156], invoice shipping_cost 188. Courier widget goes $260 -> $305, which is correct. Single-mode helper text is unchanged. No console errors. Test data cleaned up.

issues: The week selector still uses Monday-to-Monday weeks ('Lunes 19-Octubre - Lunes 26-Octubre'), while /admin/shipments uses Thursday-to-Wednesday weeks. The two pages can count different shipments for 'the same week'. This existed before this fix and is outside the request; flagging it for consistency.
The category label shows the key ('B | B'), not the tenant label. This was already known and is out of scope.

action_items: Optional: move the Packages Report week selector to the same Thursday 00:00 -> Wednesday 23:59 week helper as AdminShipments.
critical_code_review_comments: update_shipment: packages is set to None only when shipping_category or package_count is sent. A legacy edit that sends only shipping_cost would leave a stale packages array. The current UI always sends both, so this does not happen today.
getWeekKey/getCurrentWeekKey in AdminShipments.jsx are near-duplicates. AdminPackagesReport has its own Monday-based getWeekKey. Extract one shared utility.
AdminShipments.jsx is still about 2050 lines; consider splitting it.
seed_data_creation: Seeded TEST-UI-MULTI / TEST-UI-LEGACY invoices for M5358 and created 2 shipments in the UI. All removed with seed_multi_pkg_ui.py cleanup.
test_credentials: test@preview.com / test123. The login inputs use placeholders 'Usuario' / 'Contraseña'; use visible=true because there are hidden duplicates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 'python /app/backend/tests/seed_multi_pkg_ui.py seed|show|cleanup' for test invoices. Tenant rates: G 32/35 courier, A 42/35, B 52/45 (packages mode).
rca of the issue: Both earlier bugs were resolved by the main agent: (1) the PUT handler now nulls packages on a single-category edit; (2) the Monday-noon getWeekKey shadows were removed, so the default week key and the option keys match.
